facts.fact: Voice 首次给「Cursed King 无法战胜」的论据（更强/更老练/更无道德）—— annoyingly chatty of late
facts.anchor: It’s not. The Dark Voice mocked. He’s stronger than you.

facts.fact: 王座厅伏击：七议会全员+Guardian 在场；Larissa 刀架 Felix 喉、Fraener 被 suppression collar（链结被压制成背景嗡鸣）
facts.anchor: standing at each of their sides were their Guardians

facts.fact: Larissa 当众揭穿：Felix 偷书被抓现行→她拼图完成→「trials 那天也是偷力赢的。She's evil.」
Tevi 补刀：同谋（知情不报者）同罪处死——Felix 也在死罪名单
facts.anchor: Any collaborators are to be put to death too.

facts.fact: 她吸空气之力（灯闪/吊灯摇/地颤）恶魔音威胁——「他们说我怪物？那就看看真怪物」
facts.anchor: Let him go, or I will drain you all.

facts.fact: 收尾：四样她会烧掉整个 realm 的东西——村/母/Fraener/「him」；「他在不在名单上？」她自己也不知道
facts.anchor: There were only four things she truly cared about.
